summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Meadows Union Elementary School District to issue $1.8 million in bonds, repaid by a property tax of about $20 per $100,000 of assessed value, to fund school facility repairs and improvements.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue bonds and levy approximately $20 per $100,000 of assessed value while the bonds are outstanding.
tax.quote: issue $1,808,320 of bonds at legal rates, levy approximately $20/$100,000 of assessed value, generating approximately $131,755 annually while bonds are outstanding

schools.text: A Yes vote provides bond funding for improvements to Meadows Union Elementary School District facilities.
schools.quote: To upgrade facilities for energy efficiencies, upgrade/repair parking lots; construct a gymnasium and improve field lighting of athletic facilities

tax.text: A No vote does not authorize these bonds or the associated levy.
